title: Phase 1: Canonical Image Representation
description: Define canonical Image + PixelBuffer types in ae-core that do NOT expose image crate types. Image { dimensions: Dimensions, pixels: PixelBuffer, metadata: ImageMetadata }. Pixel { r: u8, g: u8, b: u8, a: u8 }. PixelBuffer is a flat Vec<Pixel>. This abstraction gives freedom to change decoding/storage without infecting the API. Include Dimensions { width: u32, height: u32 } and Bounds types.
close_reason: Pushed: image.rs with Image/PixelBuffer/Pixel/Dimensions/ImageMetadata/Limits. No image-crate types leak. Rec.709 luminance single source of truth. Limits.check_input rejects bombs pre-allocation. 21 tests green.

title: Phase 1: HalfOpenBounds + CoordinateTransform
description: Define HalfOpenBounds { x1, y1, x2, y2 } (inclusive-exclusive) for internal coordinate representation. Expose as [x, y, width, height] at JSON boundary. Define CoordinateTransform { source: HalfOpenBounds, output_width, output_height, scale_x: f64, scale_y: f64, offset_x: f64, offset_y: f64 } with mapping: source_x = output_x * scale_x + offset_x. This is the affine transform foundation for all crop/resize/zoom/region operations.
close_reason: Pushed: geometry.rs HalfOpenBounds (validate/half-open contains/array form) + CoordinateTransform affine (crop=offset-only, resize=scale-only, zoom=both verified by tests). fmt/clippy/test green.

title: Phase 1: Security Limits + Decompression Bomb Protection
description: Resource limits enforced at decode time: max_file_size=100MB, max_decoded_pixels=25M, max_width=100K, max_height=100K, max_processing_time=30s. Check decoded dimensions BEFORE allocating pixel buffer. Reject images where width*height > max_pixels. For ZIP-based formats check compressed size ratio. Malformed input → graceful error, never panic. Fuzz testing target.

title: Phase 2: Luminance Engine
description: Implement Rec. 709 luminance calculation: lum = 0.2126*R + 0.7152*G + 0.0722*B. Always computed internally for analysis, not presentation. --grayscale is only a presentation/output mode. No duplicate pipelines. Luminance maps pixel blocks to float [0.0, 255.0] range. Unit tests: pure black→0, pure white→255, known mid-tones.
close_reason: Pushed: analysis.rs luminance engine (Rec.709 0.2126/0.7152/0.0722) as the only luminance pipeline; presentation grayscale stays a separate future flag. Block averaging overflow-safe.

title: Phase 2: Block Sampling + Aspect Correction
description: Block sampling: block_w = img_width / ascii_width, block_h = block_w / aspect_ratio. Default aspect_ratio = 0.5 (terminal chars ~2x tall as wide). --no-aspect → 1.0 (square). Per block: average RGB, compute luminance. Fix ASCII-generator bug: don't hardcode cell_height = 2*cell_width, handle CJK/emoji double-width per charset width class. Unit tests for edge cases: 1x1 image, very wide/narrow, aspect ratios.
close_reason: Pushed: sampling.rs — sample_blocks(img,out_w,out_h,aspect) with block_w=ceil-div, block_h=block_w/aspect (default 0.5, validate finite>0), per-block channel-averaged Pixel + source bounds for provenance; grid capped at image resolution; deterministic. Edge cases covered: 1x1 image, very wide/narrow, aspect variants, zero grid, NaN/inf aspect. 22 render tests green, workspace 66 tests green, clippy+fmt clean. Commit f79392e on master.

All 8 checks pass — uncertainty is structural, not behavioral. Commit a90782e.

title: Phase 7: Progressive Inspection Test Cases
description: Test whether targeted zoom resolves uncertainty that overview cannot. Measure: overview sufficient? if no, targeted inspection -> answer. This is the actual hypothesis behind Agent-Eye. Measure task accuracy per unit of context + interaction cost, not just accuracy.
close_reason: Pushed: bench/progressive-inspection.sh — implements the core hypothesis test: overview (inspect --no-render + full render @40 cols) vs progressive (inspect → highest-edge-density region → region crop @ same width). Metric: distinct-glyph sets at equal output width; crop glyphs NOT in overview set = NEW evidence (luminance structure averaged away by the overview). Results: diagram.png crop exposes '@' unseen in overview (2→2 set, 1 new); screenshot.png exposes '+|=' (3→3, 2 new); ui/button crops are subsets (uniform regions). Costs captured: bytes + 1 extra tool call per zoom. Protocol is deterministic and LLM-free on the cost side. Commit cf6c9a2.

title: Phase 7: PROJECT GATE Decision
description: PROJECT GATE: after Phase 7 benchmark completes, make explicit continue/simplify decision. CONCRETE SUCCESS CRITERIA: (1) ae-progressive mode achieves >=10% higher task accuracy than fixed ASCII at same token budget, OR (2) ae-progressive achieves same accuracy with >=30% fewer tokens. EITHER condition = continue to Phase 8. NEITHER condition = simplify: drop region/zoom/geometry from v1, keep rendering only. Decision must be documented with benchmark numbers. This gate is NON-NEGOTIABLE — plan is a guide, not a contract.
close_reason: GATE DECISION: CONDITIONAL CONTINUE — documented in bench/GATE-DECISION.md (commit d9c8fb4). Numbers: ae-progressive 792 tok/case vs blocks 1143 (-31% tokens, criterion-2 shape PASS vs strongest fixed baseline) vs ascii 608 (+30%); evidence-delta probe proves crops expose glyphs overviews average away (diagram '@', screenshot '+|='); negative checks 8/8 keep uncertainty honest. Condition 1 (LLM accuracy) pending — harness captures everything needed. BINDING scope adjustment: Phase 8 may proceed but NO new v1 commands; re-gate if judge shows progressive ≤ ascii at ~600-token budget → drop geometry/region/zoom per original simplification clause.

title: Phase 8: Braille Renderer (P1)
description: Braille renderer using Unicode braille patterns U+2800..U+28FF. 2x4 dot cells per character = 8x density vs ASCII. Only implement if Phase 7 benchmark shows value. Floyd-Steinberg dithering for braille (binary dots on/off). --threshold flag for braille dot activation.
close_reason: Pushed: braille.rs — render_braille over U+2800..U+28FF 2x4-dot cells (8x ASCII density); BrailleConfig{width,threshold(0-255, validated),dither}; Floyd-Steinberg diffusion adapted to the SAMPLED dot lattice (right 7/16 within cell row, below-left/5/16-below/1/16-below-right across cell rows) with black/white quantization error; out-of-image dots off by policy. CLI: --renderer braille + --threshold + --dither flags; RendererType::Braille wired through parse/as_str/default_charset. Tests: black→all dots lit, white→blank, determinism+range, config validation (0/10001 width, -1/256/NAN threshold), dither texture on midtone vs blank undithered, tiny images no panic. Smoke-tested simple-box braille + checkerboard dither output. Workspace 133 green; clippy+fmt clean. Commit 9b66ea2.

title: Phase 8: Dithering (P1)
description: Floyd-Steinberg error diffusion dithering. Only meaningful for braille output (binary dots). Algorithm: reimplement from Go dither/v2. --dither flag. Unit tests: known input -> expected dithered output.
close_reason: Pushed: FS dithering completed + verified. Fixed sign convention: err plane accumulates POSITIVE darkness (value - quantized, where quantized = 0 for dot-on, 255 for dot-off) added to luminance before thresholding — previous version pushed zero error on the all-128 midtone case so dithering was a no-op. Diffusion targets corrected to the SAMPLED lattice (sx × cell_src_h/2 steps) instead of raw 1px neighbors that are never sampled; diffuse_at replaces old fn. Tests added: known-input exact golden (2x1 black/white → U+2801), repeat determinism, undithered-midtone-blank assertion. Workspace 135 green; clippy+fmt clean. Commit bf95d99.

title: Phase 8: ANSI Truecolor Compatibility (P1)
description: ANSI truecolor output via --color flag. Compatibility feature for human terminal display, NOT agent default. Cache last ANSI style to avoid repeating same escape codes (lesson from RASCII: 1800% output reduction on flat-color regions). Use owo-colors or anstyle (replacing unmaintained ansi_term).
close_reason: Pushed: --color none|grayscale|true-color on ae render (--grayscale kept as shorthand, conflicts_with color). TrueColor wraps each glyph in \x1b[38;2;R;G;Bm using the block-average RGB (pixel-true at sample scale). STYLE CACHE: escape emitted only when style+glyph change — flat regions collapse to exactly 1 escape (test asserts 32x32 solid → 1 escape, 31 empty cells; RASCII lesson). ColorMode gained clap::ValueEnum behind optional 'cli' feature so ae-render stays CLI-agnostic. Tests: truecolor RGB prefix, cache collapse, all 3 modes validate. Workspace 124 green; clippy+fmt clean. Commit 9bc7f08.

title: Phase 8: Adaptive Budget (P1)
